source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how to combine work done by two people or pumps working together on the same task.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Individual rate is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how to combine work done by two people or pumps working' is answered as individual rate rather than unit of work.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Individual rate is what produces unit of work, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how to combine work done by two people or pumps.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: unit of work is settled by running 'Decide how to solve an inverse-proportion problem using the constant': If x and y are inversely proportional, then x1 * y1 = x2 * y2 = k; the missing value is — on the item about Decide how to combine work done by two people or pumps.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Unit of work is computed by squaring individual rate and leaving unit of work linear, so the written value is 25 — on the item about Decide how to combine work done by two people or pumps.

intelligence.enrichment: For a shared task, add the amount of work each person or pump completes in one unit of time, then use that combined rate to find the time for one whole unit of work.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_08/ch_203. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key.
